candidate_selection_disclosure: Candidate boundaries were selected after one unreplicated SF1 mechanism probe. That probe is development information, so this admission cannot be relabeled as independent holdout evidence.
candidate_selection_principle: retain fused as the native DuckDB baseline
exclude broad branch materializations that are mechanically high-work in the mechanism probe
admission_gate: all four physical plans per query remain distinct
both queries have a confidence-authorized singleton winner beyond 3 percent
Q3 and Q10 have different singleton winners
paired-ratio half drift remains at or below 20 percent
scientific_boundary: Passing authorizes design of a new SF10 protocol and cross-query selector. It does not itself authorize latency, speedup, or optimizer-generalization claims.
